A '''[[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone navigation officer]]''' was stationed on a medical [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] during the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] medical convoy, which included the ''Pelta''-class frigate, was attacked near the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]], the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], under command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The ship was badly damaged and it's occupants, this [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] along with a fellow naval officer and a [[Unidentified clone medical officer (Ryndellia system)/Legends|medical officer]], were forced to evacuate using [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. The pods were later shot down by the ''Malevolence''.<ref name="Shadow" />
